name: Sandbag Bear-Hug Carry
steps: Stand over the sandbag, bend your hips and knees and gather it against your thighs.
Wrap both arms around the bag and stand, drawing it against your chest.
Brace your core, pull your shoulders back, and walk forward with brisk, controlled steps over the target distance.
Hinge smoothly at your hips and knees to lower the sandbag safely back to the floor when finished.
tips: Keep your chest proud and avoid leaning excessively backward to balance the heavy sandbag.
Take short, steady strides and keep breathing steadily behind a tight core brace.
